map.输入PDOP值、卫星数、HDOP/VDOP等参数，评估GPS定位精度等级: Enter PDOP, number of satellites, HDOP/VDOP and other parameters to assess the GPS positioning accuracy grade
map.📖 查看「GPS 定位精度与 PDOP 评估使用指南」: 📖 View the "GPS Positioning Accuracy and PDOP Assessment User Guide"
map.外业前评估当前卫星几何构型的定位精度是否达标。: Before fieldwork, assess whether the positioning accuracy of the current satellite geometry meets the standard.
map.判断 PDOP 是否满足 RTK、静态或快速静态测量的精度要求。: Determine whether PDOP satisfies the accuracy requirements of RTK, static or fast-static surveys.
map.结合 DOP 与误差等级选择最佳观测时段。: Combine DOP and the error grade to choose the best observation window.
map.UERE 取 3m 时：PDOP=2 → 三维误差≈±6m；PDOP=5 → ≈: With UERE = 3 m: PDOP=2 → 3D error ≈ ±6 m; PDOP=5 → ≈ ±15 m; PDOP=10 → ≈ ±30 m. Smaller DOP means higher accuracy; generally <5 is considered good.
map.PDOP≤1 理想、≤2 优秀、≤5 良好、≤10 一般、>10 差；可见卫星: PDOP ≤1 ideal, ≤2 excellent, ≤5 good, ≤10 fair, >10 poor; fewer than 5 visible satellites cannot give reliable 3D positioning, wait for satellites or switch to RTK.
map.位置精度因子，反映卫星空间几何构型对定位误差的放大倍数，值越小几何构型越好、精度: Position Dilution of Precision; it reflects how much the satellite spatial geometry amplifies positioning error; a smaller value means better geometry and higher accuracy.
map.HDOP / VDOP 与 PDOP 关系？: What is the relation among HDOP / VDOP and PDOP?
map.HDOP 为平面精度因子、VDOP 为高程精度因子，满足 PDOP²=HDOP²: HDOP is the horizontal and VDOP the vertical precision factor, satisfying PDOP² = HDOP² + VDOP²; error = DOP × UERE.
map.PDOP反映卫星几何分布对定位精度的影响，越小越好: PDOP reflects the effect of satellite geometry on positioning accuracy; smaller is better
map.定位误差≈PDOP×UERE，UERE通常3-6m: Positioning error ≈ PDOP × UERE; UERE is usually 3–6 m
map.差分GPS(RTK)可将精度从米级提升到厘米级: Differential GPS (RTK) can improve accuracy from meter to centimeter level
map.可见卫星数应≥4颗方可3D定位，≥6颗较可靠: At least 4 visible satellites are needed for 3D positioning; 6 or more is more reliable
map.GPS定位精度评估工具，输入PDOP/HDOP/VDOP值和卫星数，自动估算定位: GPS positioning accuracy assessment tool: enter PDOP/HDOP/VDOP values and satellite count to automatically estimate positioning error and determine the accuracy grade.
